dict.string: Firstlight reads the calendars in your Calendar app to show what is coming up today and tomorrow. Only if you turn it on, it also adds the events you create in Firstlight, and it only ever changes or deletes events it added itself.

Firstlight reads the calendars in your Calendar app to show what is coming up today and tomorrow. Only if you turn it on, it also adds the events you create in Firstlight, and it only ever changes or deletes events it added itself.
Firstlight asks Mail for your unread messages and meeting invitations so it can summarise them. It never changes or sends mail.
